headline: Alphabet Cloud revenue doubles, but an investment loss and negative free cash flow hit the stock
summary: Q3 revenue rose 25% and Google Cloud rose 103% with operating margin at 36%. An $8.7B equity-securities loss cut EPS 26% y/y, quarterly free cash flow was -$9.1B, and shares fell about 10% after hours.

headline: Fed holds at 3.75-4% in a 10-2 vote, two dissenters wanted a hike
summary: Cook and Hammack dissented in favour of a quarter-point increase. Chair Warsh gave no forward guidance, and economists widely expect a December hike.

headline: Apple launches its first touchscreen Mac
summary: The new MacBook Pro has a tandem-OLED touch display and M5 Pro/Max chips, starting at $2,899. Pre-orders are open and deliveries start Nov 6.

headline: Memory names rally on SK Hynix record profit
summary: Micron rose about 6% after SK Hynix posted a record quarterly profit ahead of estimates. Nvidia slipped about 1%.

headline: GE Vernova Q3 beats on orders; guidance up, buyback doubled, Trench deal
summary: Orders ~$29.3B (+96%), backlog ~$197B, full-year guidance raised. Buyback authorisation up from $10B to $20B. Agreed to acquire Trench Group.

headline: SK hynix posts record Q3; HBM4 in full mass production
summary: Operating profit ~KRW 83.3T (+38% QoQ), revenue over KRW 100T, ~80% margin. Net income down QoQ because Q2 included a one-off Kioxia gain. Shares rose after hours.

headline: Fed holds at 3.75-4.00%, two dissents for a hike
summary: 10-2 vote; Warsh says inflation too high but wants more data before December. 10-yr rose to 5.05%, 2-yr fell to 4.67%.

headline: Enphase Q3 flat sequentially, Q4 guide points lower
summary: Revenue was down 29% y/y, sell-through grew 1% against a 10% plan, and Europe fell 11%. Q4 guidance assumes sell-through down about 10% and gross margin of 40-43%.

headline: Robinhood record revenue, but crypto slump sends shares down about 8%
summary: Revenue rose 12% to a record $1.42B. Crypto revenue fell 55% y/y, GAAP EPS fell 16%, and Ohio issued a cease-and-desist over sports event contracts.

headline: Teradyne Q3 revenue $1.31B, up 70% YoY, above guidance
summary: Non-GAAP EPS $2.29. Semi Test $1,072M. Revenue slightly below Q2.

headline: Nvidia takes $3B of Meta's upsized equity raise, expands Muse and Vera Rubin deal
summary: Meta upsized its common offering to $25B from $22.5B, up to $37.5B with depositary shares, and Nvidia will invest $3B. Meta will deploy more Nvidia Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs and networking for its Muse agents.

headline: Micron Taoyuan union talks end without a deal; third round set for Nov 6
summary: The second session with the Taoyuan union on Oct 27 produced no agreement, and the city labour bureau set a third round for Nov 6. No further strike has been announced since the 24-hour warning strike on Oct 22.

headline: Chips extend rally; Kospi up 3.8%, Nikkei up 1.7% on Anthropic IPO optimism
summary: SK hynix rose 7.1% and Samsung 5.2%, and the Kospi triggered a buy-side sidecar. The S&P 500 opened up 0.3% Tuesday after Monday's 0.7% gain.

headline: Fed meeting begins; futures price about 10% chance of a hike
summary: Hold expected despite hot inflation, decision Wednesday 2pm ET (Thursday 5am AEDT). Traders will watch for a December hike signal.

headline: SK hynix up 5.2% in Seoul on eve of Q3 and return plan
summary: Shares closed at KRW 1,341,000 as the KOSPI rose 3.09% and foreigners net bought KRW 836B, a rally credited to Anthropic's IPO filing; Korean press report a KRW 50-60T return package, unconfirmed.

headline: Vertiv closes $1.45B UtilityInnovation Group purchase
summary: Adds microgrid controls and behind-the-meter power systems for AI data centres, with up to $1.15B more in earnout; expected to add to adjusted EPS in year one.

headline: Citi upgrades MercadoLibre to Buy after election selloff
summary: Citi moved to Buy from Neutral with a $2,050 target, a day after the stock fell 7.8% on Lula's win.

headline: Sea sets Q3 results for Nov 10
summary: Results before the US open on Nov 10 with a call at 7:30am ET (23:30 AEDT).

headline: Anthropic S-1: 48% of revenue via Google, Amazon, Microsoft clouds; $114.5B Google commitment
summary: Anthropic sold 48% of its first-half revenue through cloud marketplaces, up from 11% in 2023, and committed at least $114.5B to Google through 2033 and $110B to Amazon through 2036. Q2 sales were $11.6B with a $974M operating profit.

headline: Celestica beats Q3 and guides 2027 revenue to $40B
summary: Q3 revenue $5.83B (+83%) and adjusted EPS $3.30 topped guidance; 2026 raised to $21.0B, and 2027 guided to $40B revenue and $21.50 EPS. Shares were up about 10% early Tuesday.

headline: Banks and Blackstone line up $63B to finance Broadcom chips for Anthropic
summary: A new vehicle will buy Broadcom accelerators and networking and lease them to Anthropic from 2027; about $43.5B is senior debt and Broadcom provides residual-value support to lenders.

headline: CoreWeave five-year CDS at 1,148bp, off an Oct 22 peak of 1,167bp
summary: S&P Global data imply about a 62% five-year default probability, versus 835bp a month earlier.

headline: Anthropic publicly files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
summary: H1 2026 revenue was $16.3B, up 1,300% year on year. The net loss was $80.7B, mostly non-cash charges on financing instruments. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley lead the deal, and reports put the valuation at $1.5-2T with listing in mid-November.

headline: Anthropic S-1: about $3.1B a month to SpaceX for Nvidia-GPU compute
summary: The filing commits up to $120.5B into 2029 for SpaceX compute on Nvidia GPUs, plus deals with Microsoft, Nscale and Lambda. Meanwhile neoclouds Nvidia backs are down 30%+ in October, which tests its $36B in off-balance-sheet backstops.

headline: Meta launches $35B equity offering to fund AI buildout
summary: The offering is $22.5B of Class A stock via forward sales plus $12.5B of mandatory convertible preferred. A further ~$60B non-voting Class C at-the-market program is planned from Q1 2027. Shares swung from -4% to +1% premarket.

headline: Lula wins Brazil runoff; Brazil ADRs plunge
summary: Lula won about 51.8% to 48.2% for a fourth term, and Flavio Bolsonaro says he will challenge the result. The Brazil ETF fell more than 27% premarket, Petrobras about 22% and MercadoLibre about 11%.

headline: Futures price ~91% hold at Oct 27-28 FOMC, ~80% December hike
summary: US futures rose Monday as Brent eased after Trump ruled out an immediate Iran strike. The 10-year is near 5%. The decision is due Thu 5am AEDT, followed by Warsh's press conference.

headline: Lula wins Brazil runoff; MELI down 11.7% at the open
summary: The electoral court declared Lula the winner with about 51.8% to 48.2%; Flavio Bolsonaro refused to concede and will seek annulment. MELI opened at $1,578 and traded at $1,598 early, from $1,810; Brazil ETFs and real futures fell about 10-19% overnight.

headline: SK hynix weighs $12B special dividend from Kioxia gains
summary: Dong-A Ilbo reported a KRW 16T (about $12B) special dividend could come with Q3 on Wednesday; the company has said only that a shareholder-return plan will be announced then. The ADR rose 3.3% early Monday.

headline: KOSPI falls 1.46% to 5,469 before chip earnings; SK hynix flat
summary: Foreign investors sold KRW 696B of Korean shares; SK hynix closed down 0.16% at KRW 1.28M after an early rally faded, and Samsung fell 1.16%.

headline: Meta plans up to $95B stock raise for AI build-out; Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom may buy
summary: Meta launched $35B of underwritten common and mandatory convertible offerings, with a $60B at-the-market programme from Q1 2027; its first new stock since 2013. Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom indicated non-binding interest in up to $5B.

headline: Musk says debt markets have shut on neoclouds; CoreWeave near 52-week low
summary: Elon Musk posted that debt financing has 'almost entirely shut off' for firms without revenue outside AI data centres and predicted neocloud failures. CoreWeave fell up to 4.5% pre-open; Raymond James, Morgan Stanley and UBS cut targets.

headline: New Street cuts Sea to Neutral, $70 target; shares at a new low
summary: Sea fell 3.5% early to $71.99, a new 52-week low, after the downgrade, extending the slide since its Oct 20 Sea Cloud memo.

headline: Vertiv completes King Environmental Services purchase
summary: The deal adds fluid-management services for high-density data centres across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, two days before Q3 results.

headline: Brazil runoff too close to call; Lula slightly ahead at half count
summary: TSE had Lula 50.14% and Flavio Bolsonaro 49.86% with about half counted, after the lead swapped several times. Prediction markets favoured Lula; a Lula win would weigh on Brazilian assets.

headline: Taoyuan members reject Micron profit-sharing offer; talks pushed to Oct 27 by typhoon
summary: About 70% of voting members rejected the offer. Micron's new global quarterly bonus starts in fiscal 2027, but the union wants a fixed 15% of operating profit.

headline: OpenAI nears up to $30B round at $1.25T, down from $1.4T target
summary: Coatue and UAE funds are reported to be leading the round, seen as a bridge to a possible 2027 IPO. Nothing has been signed or announced.

headline: Alphabet reports Wed Oct 28; consensus about $128B revenue
summary: Results come after the close, with the call at 4:30pm ET. Consensus EPS is about $3.02-3.04. Cloud growth against rising capex is the focus.

headline: S&P 500 -0.5%, Nasdaq -0.7% for the week; second straight weekly loss
summary: S&P 500 closed at 7,623.68 and the Nasdaq at 25,955.34 on Oct 23; the Dow rose 0.4% and the Russell 2000 2.0% on the week. Rising oil weighed on Friday.

headline: Brent hits about $116, highest since June 2022, up 5% on the week
summary: Driven by talk of renewed US strikes on Iran and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia; the war is not settled, with Hormuz navigation the main sticking point. WTI near $102.50.

headline: 10-year falls 8bp on the week to 5.00% as money leaves AI stocks
summary: First weekly close below 5% in four weeks; 2-year 4.69%, 30-year 5.32%. Futures still price one more hike in December; CME put October hike odds near 9% (hold about 91%) ahead of the Oct 27-28 meeting.

headline: Anthropic and Hg plan a European AI consulting firm, per FT
summary: Offices in London and Berlin, starting by end-2026, aiming for a valuation above $10B within five years. Adds services revenue ahead of the planned November IPO.

headline: Anthropic merges Claude chat and Cowork into one experience for Enterprise
summary: Chats move into a cloud sandbox when a task needs code or files. It is off by default for existing organisations and turns on by default Nov 16.

headline: Cloudflare up 5.5% on Friday against a flat sector as analysts lift targets
summary: Several brokers raised targets ahead of Q3 results (high $430). It also upsized a $2.5B zero-coupon convertible due 2031.

headline: Robinhood ends the week about 37% below its 52-week high ahead of Q3
summary: Shares fell 1.6% Friday after losing ground in Thursday's chip selloff. Q3 is due Tue Oct 27 after the close (Wed ~07:00 AEDT); consensus is about $1.44B revenue, up 13%.

headline: Apple briefly passes Nvidia as most valuable company on iPhone Duo launch day
summary: The $1,999 foldable went on sale Oct 23 and Apple's market cap touched about $5.1T at an intraday record. Shares closed down 0.14%, leaving Nvidia back on top.

headline: BYD up 4.4% in Hong Kong on a sector bounce; Q3 results due Oct 29
summary: Not company-specific. The Oct 22 session fell about 4% after China car retail for Oct 1-18 was down 26% y/y. BYD is also seeking to double its Brazil plant to 600,000 a year.

headline: Credo down 19% in two days as MaxLinear targets its cable market
summary: MaxLinear said it aims for 20-30% of 1.6T active electrical cables within a couple of years, where it puts Credo's share at 93-99%. Research also pointed to slower 1.6T rollouts; Credo closed at $147.29.

headline: SK hynix drops Solidigm Nasdaq listing; shares rebound 4.4%
summary: SK hynix abandoned plans to list its US NAND unit after shareholder pushback. Seoul shares rose 4.4% to KRW 1,277,000 and the ADR 4.1% to $137.02, as the KOSPI reversed a 4% intraday drop.

headline: OpenAI trims funding-round target to $1.25T
summary: The target for a raise of up to $30B was cut from $1.4T after investor pushback. Commitments are due Oct 30, ahead of Anthropic's expected mid-November IPO.

headline: Meta falls about 7%, Nasdaq drops 2.6% as AI spending fears spread
summary: The Nasdaq had its worst day since June and the Philadelphia chip index fell 6.7%. Marvell fell 8.7%, Micron 6.3% and TSMC 4.5%, while Treasury yields fell sharply as money moved to safety.

headline: Lam Research supply warning deepens chip selloff
summary: Lam's CEO said clean room space and component shortages will constrain chipmakers into 2027. Marvell, AMD and Intel fell 7-8% in morning trade.

headline: Micron Taoyuan strike goes ahead with 11 union officials, no output disruption
summary: The 24-hour solidarity strike followed Micron's deal with the larger Taichung union. The union said it was not meant to disrupt production but warned more workers could join.

headline: Alibaba falls as China tells e-commerce platforms to tighten quality controls
summary: The State Administration for Market Regulation flagged risks in livestream sales and quick retail. Shares fell as much as 6.3% and the Hang Seng Tech index dropped 5.2% intraday.

headline: Rocket sets Q3 results for Oct 29
summary: Results come out before a 4:30pm ET call on Thu Oct 29. Mortgage lenders rose on Oct 22 as Treasury yields fell.

headline: Figure sets Q3 results for Nov 12, small business lending tops $100M a quarter
summary: Figure reports before the open on Nov 12, with the call at 8:30am ET. Its small business financing ecosystem had its first $50M month and first $100M quarter.

headline: Chip index falls more than 6% in a day after Lam cites supply constraints
summary: Lam said Q4 guidance would have been higher without supply limits and fell as much as 11%; Marvell fell 9%, Intel and Applied Materials 7%, ASML 6%. AI funding worries and higher oil added to the selling.

headline: Bloom Energy Q3 revenue up 138% to $1.24B; raises 2026 guidance to $4.4-4.6B
summary: Third raise this year; gross margin 33.8%, GAAP operating margin 18.2%. Bloom also joined the S&P 500, citing hyperscaler demand for onsite power.

headline: Spotify Q3: 306M subscribers, 1M ahead of guide; Q4 guide 316M and EUR 820M operating income
summary: Revenue EUR 4.97B, up 14% in constant currency; gross margin 33.0%; operating income EUR 672M; free cash flow EUR 735M. MAU 788M.

headline: Spotify shares up about 7-10% on the subscriber beat and Q4 guide
summary: Both the subscriber and operating income guides for Q4 came in above analyst expectations, which outweighed revenue slightly below estimates.

headline: Bloom Q3 revenue +138% to $1.24B, 2026 guide raised to $4.4-4.6B; stock falls 11%
summary: Record revenue and adjusted EPS of $0.94 beat; full-year guidance was raised for the third time. Shares fell 11.2% on Oct 23 to $193.30 on -$181M free cash flow from capacity capex and the AI selloff.

headline: SOX falls 6.7% after Lam flags supply limits; all 30 members down
summary: Lam said supply constraints trimmed an estimated $300-400M from its Dec-quarter guide and could limit the industry into 2027. ASML fell 6.9%, Teradyne 10.6%, Astera 11.1%; Meta fell 7% on capex and $810B of commitments.

headline: GE Vernova falls 10.6% with AI-power stocks after Meta results
summary: No company news; the drop came with the AI selloff, with commentary citing valuation and wind losses. It closed Oct 23 at $815, about 31% below its June record, ahead of Q3 on Oct 28.

headline: Meta Q3 beats on revenue but capex rises, free cash flow turns negative
summary: Revenue rose 26% to $64.6B and the Q4 guide of $73-76B was in line or better, but 2026 capex is now $135-145B, Q3 free cash flow was -$2.1B and buybacks are paused. A non-voting Class C share, one per existing share, arrives Jan 2027.

headline: Meta Q3 revenue up 26% to $64.6B, Q4 guide $73-76B; shares up after hours
summary: GAAP EPS was $3.83 after a $9.9B charge for the state attorneys general settlement ($7.40 excluding it). 2026 capex is now $135-145B (was $130-145B), with no 2027 figure given yet; shares rose 3-5% after hours.

headline: Meta to issue non-voting Class C shares as a one-for-one stock dividend
summary: Effective January 2027, each Class A and B share gets one Class C share, which works like a two-for-one split with no change to voting control. Q3 capex of $34.9B exceeded operating cash flow, and Meta expects Reality Labs losses near $15B next year.

headline: Huang at GTC Berlin: every European company will become an AI company
summary: Nvidia showed a factory-built DSX POD data center module on Vera Rubin that can be deployed in about two weeks, and said it has committed nearly $10B to Europe's tech ecosystem. Shares rose 2.5% on the day.

headline: Micron signs labour deal with Taichung union; Taoyuan strike still planned
summary: The Taichung union signed a collective agreement and cancelled the Oct 22 mediation. The Taoyuan union, which wants 15% of operating profit shared with staff, had not called off its one-day warning strike.

headline: Alphabet slips ahead of Oct 28 results; KeyBanc trims target
summary: KeyBanc cut its target to $410 from $435 (still Overweight), and a London Google Cloud data center outage on Oct 20 disrupted UK banks. OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden.

headline: Alibaba falls about 4% as US-listed China tech sells off
summary: No single trigger; coverage cites heavy AI capex weighing on free cash flow, weak Chinese consumer spending and chip export limits.

headline: Tesla Q3: EPS and cash flow beat, revenue a hair light, stock flat to slightly up after hours
summary: Adj. EPS $0.48 vs $0.44 expected, revenue $28.05B vs $28.13B, free cash flow +$1.53B vs an expected $4.9B outflow, and Q3 capex $4.7B. Full-year capex is guided above $25B for Optimus (now in production at Fremont), AI compute, Cybercab and Terafab; shares rose 3.4% in the session and about 0.5% after hours.

headline: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, an always-on agent, as a research preview
summary: Claude Duet runs on its own cloud computer, handling email, calendar and app tasks in the background, and asks before sending, paying or deleting anything. It is rolling out by waitlist to US Pro and Max subscribers at no extra cost.

headline: Robinhood up about 4% after Rosenblatt starts coverage at Buy
summary: Rosenblatt initiated at Buy with a $135 target and called it a "generational growth story", and a bitcoin rebound lifted crypto-linked names. Q3 results are due next week.

headline: BYD falls about 3% as September China retail drops 29% and CATL disappoints
summary: BYD's domestic passenger retail sales were 246,816 in September (down 28.9% y/y), though it still led with a 22.8% NEV share and overseas sales are booming. Q3 results are due Oct 29.

headline: Lam Research down 6% after hours despite a beat, while TXN guides Q4 above estimates
summary: Lam posted revenue of $8.22B vs $8.13B and guided December to $8.6B +/- $0.4B (consensus $8.54B), but the wide range and an 80% one-year run prompted selling. Texas Instruments revenue rose 28% to $6.06B and it guided Q4 EPS to $2.45-2.79 vs $2.27 expected.

headline: Brent touched $112 on Iranian mine claims in Hormuz, then settled near $109
summary: The IRGC claimed mines stopped three tankers on a route it calls unauthorized, and the US disputes the claims. Prices eased after Iran said indirect talks with Washington continue; Brent settled at $108.79 Tuesday and $108.82 Wednesday.

headline: BofA previews 44% Q3 order growth; GE Vernova up 4%
summary: BofA reaffirmed Buy ($1,310) ahead of the Oct 28 report, forecasting about 44% y/y order growth. GE Vernova also won a 9E turbine order for a 372 MW plant in Cote d'Ivoire.

headline: Netflix beats on Q3 EPS but cuts 2026 ad revenue forecast to $2.7B
summary: Q3 revenue was $12.9B (+12%) and EPS $0.87 against $0.82 expected. 2026 revenue guidance is $51.1B, slightly below the prior midpoint, and Q4 margin guidance includes the cost of headcount cuts.

headline: Netflix falls about 6% after hours as ads lag and layoffs are announced
summary: Management said the ads business is behind target because of delayed product rollouts, though ad revenue is still growing over 80%. Full 2027 guidance comes in January.

headline: Micron Taoyuan union calls one-day solidarity strike for Oct 22
summary: The union represents about 2,400 of roughly 3,000 Taoyuan workers; it has not said how many will walk out, and no production impact has been reported.
